_about: Ride UK's village set (the everyday kits plan, stage 6): original designs of UK schools, modelled by Tools/blender_village_kit.py with the farm kit's bays and cut into pieces by Tools/blender_farm_kit_export.py (this file and village_kit.bin) in the warehouse kit's format. World/WorldRideBuildings.cpp gives a school the map draws the design that suits its size and the place's walls and lays it with BuildWarehouse. Classes: school_old_brick, school_old_stone, school_old (small, old), school_new, school_small.
